doc: A natural number is good when it is even.
name: Uses.Good

doc: The good numbers, as a set: a reference to `Good` in a definition's body.
name: Uses.goodSet

doc: The general lemma: a good positive number exceeds its half.
name: Uses.half_lt
type: ∀ (n : Nat), Uses.Good n → 0 < n → n / 2 < n

doc: The first caller assumes the extra condition.
name: Uses.caller_assumes
type: ∀ (m : Nat), Uses.Good m → 0 < m → m / 2 < m

doc: The second caller proves the condition for the number it constructs.
name: Uses.caller_proves

doc: A statement that mentions `Good` without using `half_lt`.
name: Uses.good_zero

doc: Two applications whose arguments are both printed `x`, bound in different scopes.
name: Uses.twice
type: (∀ (x : Nat), Uses.Good (2 * x)) ∧ ∀ (x : Nat), Uses.Good (2 * x)

doc: An implicit type, an instance and a premise about a local list.
name: Uses.length_pos
type: ∀ {α : Type} [Inhabited α] (xs : List α) (x : α), x ∈ xs → 0 < xs.length

name: Uses.uses_instance
type: ∀ (ys : List Nat) (y : Nat), y ∈ ys → 0 < ys.length

doc: A specialised helper: the lemma at four.
name: Uses.half_lt_four

doc:
The general result the paper states: every good positive number exceeds its half, and four
exceeds two.
name: Uses.main_bound
type: ∀ (n : Nat), Uses.Good n → 0 < n → n / 2 < n ∧ 4 / 2 < 4
